facts.fact: The $900K financing was led by IAF (Investment Accelerator Fund) and Slaight Communications, and complemented by debt financing from BDC (Business Development Bank of Canada).
facts.quote: Financing, totalling $900K, was lead by IAF (Investment Accelerator Fund), Slaight Communications, and complimented by the debt financing from BDC

facts.fact: StackAdapt stated that the funds were aimed at growing its development team in Toronto and supporting satellite offices in New York and London.
facts.quote: These funds are primarily aimed to fuel further growth and expansion of their development team in Toronto, and to support the growth of their satellite offices in New York and London.

facts.fact: StackAdapt stated that its clients span 4 continents.
facts.quote: With clients spanning 4 continents, StackAdapt’s scalable technology powers the programmatic native advertising ecosystem globally.
